decisions.reason: Audio and web conferencing has become heavily commoditised by Teams and Zoom since the pandemic and is non-core, but it still complements the voice portfolio for existing enterprise customers, so it is likely kept for one more year.
Metro data centre connectivity is central to the firm's fibre, data centre and cloud strategy and has proven adoption in financial hubs.
Optical spectrum services make use of owned fibre for high-bandwidth customers and fit the firm's push toward high-capacity infrastructure.
Direct voice network connections support enterprise and carrier migration to SIP and cloud voice, so the service remains relevant despite pressure on traditional voice.
